operations.title: Verify kit at bench
operations.description: Build step: match the kit issued by stores against the work package and confirm every line is present before starting assembly.

steps.title: Pull the kit
steps.instruction: Locate the issued kit for this work order and confirm the kit label matches the work order number.

steps.title: Match part numbers
steps.instruction: Compare each kit item’s part number and lot or serial number against the Kit tab.

steps.title: Report shortages
steps.instruction: If anything is missing or damaged, stop and create an IDR / NC before continuing.

operations.title: Confirm configuration
operations.description: Confirm the work package is at the revision this work order was released to.

steps.title: Open the master WI
steps.instruction: Open the master WI and confirm its revision matches the one shown on this work order.

steps.title: Check the part revision
steps.instruction: Confirm the part number and revision on the traveler match the drawing called out in the WI.

steps.title: Confirm effectivity
steps.instruction: Verify any engineering changes listed on the work order are incorporated before starting assembly.

operations.title: Record assembly completion
operations.description: Record the build-completion note for this operation.

steps.title: Prepare the work area
steps.instruction: Clean the bench, verify the ESD mat and wrist strap, and stage the kit.

steps.title: Assemble per WI
steps.instruction: Complete the assembly sequence shown in the WI figures. Log each calibrated tool you use.

steps.title: Torque and witness mark
steps.instruction: Torque fasteners to the values in the WI and apply witness marks.

steps.title: Record completion
steps.instruction: Write a completion note describing what was built and any observations.

operations.title: Record inspection result
operations.description: Document the inspection result against the acceptance criteria for this operation.

steps.title: Set up inspection
steps.instruction: Gather the inspection tools listed in the WI and confirm they are in calibration.

steps.title: Inspect features
steps.instruction: Measure each characteristic called out in the inspection table and compare it to tolerance.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record measured values. Any out-of-tolerance result needs an NC before buy-off.

operations.title: Verify evidence package
operations.description: Check that every required work record is present before handoff.

steps.title: Collect records
steps.instruction: Confirm every prior operation has a stamp, date, and completion note.

steps.title: Check evidence
steps.instruction: Verify linked reports, photos, or recordings are attached and reviewed.

operations.title: Prepare QA handoff
operations.description: Prepare the completed record for quality review.

steps.title: Review the traveler
steps.instruction: Read through the full traveler for open items, holds, or missing entries.

steps.title: Hand off to QA
steps.instruction: Notify Quality that the work order is ready for final review.

operations.title: Confirm configuration
operations.description: Confirm the work package is at the revision this work order was released to.

steps.title: Open the master WI
steps.instruction: Open the master WI and confirm its revision matches the one shown on this work order.

steps.title: Check the part revision
steps.instruction: Confirm the part number and revision on the traveler match the drawing called out in the WI.

steps.title: Confirm effectivity
steps.instruction: Verify any engineering changes listed on the work order are incorporated before starting assembly.

operations.title: Record assembly completion
operations.description: Record the build-completion note for this operation.

steps.title: Prepare the work area
steps.instruction: Clean the bench, verify the ESD mat and wrist strap, and stage the kit.

steps.title: Assemble per WI
steps.instruction: Complete the assembly sequence shown in the WI figures. Log each calibrated tool you use.

steps.title: Torque and witness mark
steps.instruction: Torque fasteners to the values in the WI and apply witness marks.

steps.title: Record completion
steps.instruction: Write a completion note describing what was built and any observations.

operations.title: Record inspection result
operations.description: Document the inspection result against the acceptance criteria for this operation.

steps.title: Set up inspection
steps.instruction: Gather the inspection tools listed in the WI and confirm they are in calibration.

steps.title: Inspect features
steps.instruction: Measure each characteristic called out in the inspection table and compare it to tolerance.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record measured values. Any out-of-tolerance result needs an NC before buy-off.

operations.title: Verify evidence package
operations.description: Check that every required work record is present before handoff.

steps.title: Collect records
steps.instruction: Confirm every prior operation has a stamp, date, and completion note.

steps.title: Check evidence
steps.instruction: Verify linked reports, photos, or recordings are attached and reviewed.

operations.title: Prepare QA handoff
operations.description: Prepare the completed record for quality review.

steps.title: Review the traveler
steps.instruction: Read through the full traveler for open items, holds, or missing entries.

steps.title: Hand off to QA
steps.instruction: Notify Quality that the work order is ready for final review.

masterWIs.title: Flight controls integration kit master work order

operations.title: Verify kit at bench
operations.description: Build step: match the kit issued by stores against the work package and confirm every line is present before starting assembly.

steps.title: Pull the kit
steps.instruction: Locate the issued kit for this work order and confirm the kit label matches the work order number.

steps.title: Match part numbers
steps.instruction: Compare each kit item’s part number and lot or serial number against the Kit tab.

steps.title: Report shortages
steps.instruction: If anything is missing or damaged, stop and create an IDR / NC before continuing.

operations.title: Confirm configuration
operations.description: Confirm the work package is at the revision this work order was released to.

steps.title: Open the master WI
steps.instruction: Open the master WI and confirm its revision matches the one shown on this work order.

steps.title: Check the part revision
steps.instruction: Confirm the part number and revision on the traveler match the drawing called out in the WI.

steps.title: Confirm effectivity
steps.instruction: Verify any engineering changes listed on the work order are incorporated before starting assembly.

operations.title: Record assembly completion
operations.description: Record the build-completion note for this operation.

steps.title: Prepare the work area
steps.instruction: Clean the bench, verify the ESD mat and wrist strap, and stage the kit.

steps.title: Assemble per WI
steps.instruction: Complete the assembly sequence shown in the WI figures. Log each calibrated tool you use.

steps.title: Torque and witness mark
steps.instruction: Torque fasteners to the values in the WI and apply witness marks.

steps.title: Record completion
steps.instruction: Write a completion note describing what was built and any observations.

operations.title: Record inspection result
operations.description: Document the inspection result against the acceptance criteria for this operation.

steps.title: Set up inspection
steps.instruction: Gather the inspection tools listed in the WI and confirm they are in calibration.

steps.title: Inspect features
steps.instruction: Measure each characteristic called out in the inspection table and compare it to tolerance.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record measured values. Any out-of-tolerance result needs an NC before buy-off.

operations.title: Verify evidence package
operations.description: Check that every required work record is present before handoff.

steps.title: Collect records
steps.instruction: Confirm every prior operation has a stamp, date, and completion note.

steps.title: Check evidence
steps.instruction: Verify linked reports, photos, or recordings are attached and reviewed.

operations.title: Prepare QA handoff
operations.description: Prepare the completed record for quality review.

steps.title: Review the traveler
steps.instruction: Read through the full traveler for open items, holds, or missing entries.

steps.title: Hand off to QA
steps.instruction: Notify Quality that the work order is ready for final review.

history.action: Revision B started from Rev A.

cars.title: Harness connector pin retention failures at ATP
cars.description: Two harness assemblies failed pin retention at ATP. Pins backed out of the 38-pin connector under the pull test.

containment.note: Quarantined the open harness lot, 100 percent pull-tested the six finished assemblies on the shelf; two more failures found and held.

whys: Pins backed out under pull test.
Pins were not fully seated at crimp-and-insert.
The insertion tool tip was worn and did not click at full seat.
Tool wear is not on the calibration or inspection schedule.
Insertion tools were treated as consumables, not controlled tools.

Method: No seat verification step after insertion
Measurement: Pull test only at ATP, not at the operation

rootCause.statement: Insertion tools are outside tool control, so a worn tip produced unseated pins that only the ATP pull test caught.

actions.description: Bring insertion and extraction tools under tool control with a wear gauge and a six-month inspection.
actions.evidence: Tools tagged IT-001 to IT-006, added to the calibration register with wear-gauge criteria.

actions.description: Add a per-pin seat check and a sample pull test to the harness insertion step in the master WI.

history.action: Raised (Major, source FRACAS). Owner Harper Olsen.
Containment recorded.
Root cause recorded (Machine).
Action CA-1 completed.

cars.title: Torque values recorded outside tolerance on flight control installs
cars.description: Three consecutive installation work orders recorded torque values 8 to 12 percent above the drawing callout on the actuator mount fasteners. Parts were held at inspection; no escape.

containment.note: Held all open installation orders for the actuator mount step, re-verified torque on the three affected units with a calibrated wrench and re-torqued to the callout.

whys: Torque values were high on three orders.
The wrench used was set in in-lb while the step lists ft-lb.
The unit toggle on the wrench had no guard and was bumped.
The step did not state the unit prominently and the tool was not restricted to the callout.
The work instruction template lists units in a footnote, not in the step line.

Man: Operator did not re-check the unit before torquing
Method: Step lists unit in a footnote
Measurement: No independent torque verification on the step

rootCause.statement: The work instruction template presents torque units outside the step line, so a bumped wrench unit toggle went unnoticed until inspection.

actions.description: Revise the work instruction template so every torque step states value and unit in the step line and the step records both.
actions.evidence: Template Rev D released; WI-SR-FC-200 revised to Rev C with unit in every torque step.

actions.description: Fit unit-lock guards to the four floor torque wrenches and add a unit check to the tool control acknowledgement.
actions.evidence: Guards fitted on TW-001 to TW-004; calibration record updated; acknowledgement text changed.

verification.note: Reviewed template Rev D, WI-SR-FC-200 Rev C, and the four wrenches with guards fitted. Observed two torque steps executed with the unit read back before torquing.

effectiveness.note: Fourteen installation orders since the change with zero torque nonconformances; step data shows unit recorded every time.

closure.note: Root cause addressed at the template level; effectiveness demonstrated across fourteen orders.
